tests.expect: LockFileEx lock is visible while held and is released when the holder is hard-terminated (TerminateProcess)
tests.name: lockfileex-released-on-terminate
tests.note: lock visible while held, released on TerminateProcess

tests.expect: a holder that waits on its parent's handle exits when the parent is terminated, and its lock is then free
tests.name: holder-exits-when-parent-dies
tests.note: holder exited with its parent and released the lock

data.semantics: lock is owned by the locking process; an inherited handle does not keep it

tests.expect: documents borrow semantics: design assumes a handle inherited by a child does NOT keep the lock after the locking process dies (so a job-scoped holder process is needed)
tests.name: lockfileex-inherited-handle-after-parent-death
tests.note: confirms: lock dies with the locking process even if a child holds an inherited handle

tests.expect: closing the job (owner dies) kills child, grandchild and a DETACHED_PROCESS child; CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB is denied
tests.name: job-kill-on-close-whole-tree
tests.note: job close killed child, grandchild and the detached child; breakaway denied

tests.expect: QueryInformationJobObject ActiveProcesses equals the tree size and reaches 0 after the job is terminated
tests.name: job-active-process-count
tests.note: ActiveProcesses matched the tree and reached 0

tests.expect: a Toolhelp snapshot yields the parent chain from a grandchild up to the probe, fast enough for a per-call ancestry check
tests.name: toolhelp-ancestry
tests.note: ancestry chain from grandchild reaches the probe

tests.expect: kill the holder while git is blocked in a hook: lock is never observed free while git or its hook children are alive (windows: they all die with the job; unix: lock stays held through the inherited fd)
tests.name: git-borrow-blocking-hook
tests.note: lock observed free while git or a child was still alive

tests.expect: same invariant with gc.auto=1 and loose objects, killing the holder as soon as git returns while a detached gc and a background hook child may still run
tests.name: git-borrow-auto-gc
tests.note: lock never free while git or its children were alive

tests.expect: informational: whether the terminal-pane transport can exist on this OS
tests.name: herdr-on-path
